card.fact_statement: The Department of the Interior and Local Government alerted local politicians of high-risk areas during the 2025 Philippine monsoon floods.
card.answer: Department of the Interior and Local Government
card.source_span: the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla alerted local politicians of high-risk areas

target_qa_variants.question: أي وزارة حكومية نبهت السياسيين المحليين بشأن المناطق عالية المخاطر خلال فيضانات الرياح الموسمية في الفلبين عام 2025؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla alerted local politicians of high-risk areas
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Department' as 'وزارة' (Ministry) which is the standard Arabic equivalent for Philippine executive departments.

backtranslation_en.question: Which government ministry alerted local politicians about high-risk areas during the monsoon floods in the Philippines in 2025?
backtranslation_en.expected_answer: Ministry of Interior and Local Government
